scripts.build: pnpm --filter @realitycheck/config build && pnpm --filter @realitycheck/shared build && pnpm --filter @realitycheck/db build && pnpm --filter @realitycheck/explorer build && pnpm --filter @realitycheck/llm build && pnpm --filter @realitycheck/playwright-runner build && pnpm --filter @realitycheck/regression build && pnpm --filter @realitycheck/api build && pnpm --filter @realitycheck/worker build && pnpm --filter @realitycheck/web build
scripts.dev:prepare: pnpm --filter @realitycheck/config build && pnpm --filter @realitycheck/shared build && pnpm --filter @realitycheck/db build && pnpm --filter @realitycheck/llm build && pnpm --filter @realitycheck/explorer build && pnpm --filter @realitycheck/playwright-runner build && pnpm --filter @realitycheck/regression build
